draft.text: You came because you have had stomach pain on your right side for 10 days.
The pain gets worse after you eat and sometimes feels sharper when pressed.
We did not find any results from tests or exams during this visit.
Your pain may be related to a stomach or digestive issue.
You also have some nausea and heartburn, but no vomiting or fever.
The next steps will be discussed after more tests are done.
Your doctor will talk to you about the results and what to do next.
